data.gender_notes: Nudairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nudhara' which means 'to light up' or 'to illuminate'. In Islamic tradition, Nudairah symbolizes enlightenment, knowledge, and spiritual growth. The name Nudairah carries the meaning “Light, illumination” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nudairah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, illumination and live with faith, good character and purpose.
